chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad, and Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, all together from Al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Washsha, from Ahmad ibn A'idh, from Abu Khadija, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Give the Zakat to those of the Banu Hashim who desire it, for it is permissible for them, and it is prohibited only upon the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), and the Imam who comes after him, and the Imams, may the prayers of Allah be upon them all.
ai.seo_question: Can members of the Banu Hashim receive Zakat?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the distinction between the general prohibition of Zakat for the Prophet and the specific Imams, allowing other Banu Hashim members to receive it. It reflects the Shia scholarly view that the Imam's status as a recipient of divine provision (ghina) exempts him, while other Hashimites remain eligible. This ruling underscores the unique spiritual and legal standing of the Ahl al-Bayt in matters of charity distribution.

en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, and Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, altogether from Al Hassan Bin Ali Al Washa, from Ahmad Bin A’iz, from Abu Khadeeja, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘

Give the Zakaat to the ones you need it from the Clan of Hashim<sup>as</sup>, for it is Permissible for them (from each other as per the above Hadith), and rather it is Prohibited upon the Prophet<sup>saww</sup>, and the Imam<sup>asws</sup> from after him<sup>saww</sup>, and the Imams<sup>asws</sup>, all of them’.
en.sarwar: 6. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu’alla’ ibn Muhammad and Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad aff from Afi ibn al-Washsha’ from Ahmad ibn ‘ A”Iddah (waiting period) from abu Khadijah who has narrated the foiiowing: “Abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

You can pay Zakat to banu Hashim who want it because it is lawful for them. It is unlawful only for the Holy prophet, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to your cause and for the Imam after him and to ’A’immah ‘Alayhim al-Salam.’”
